no_false_fault_policy: Only a real valid-qualified detector event is retained. Unknown no-reset startup state, invalid arithmetic err, unowned return data and intentionally suppressed boot buses are not detector events.
Retained events carry the source request/pass/epoch ownership at the detection edge. A later source start/reset cannot relabel an old event to a new request.
No quiet/reset window or dynamic backpressure is introduced.

obligations.source_legal_transition: On core edge e with rs_q=1, kv_q=1 and w_rdy=0, f_ovf becomes1. With rs_q held1, kf becomes1 on e+1; every actual selected kc_* kf port is omitted.
obligations.observable_obligation: Command rejection must veto the owning request's commit and future use; no selected external kf connection supplies that obligation.
obligations.global_legal_trace_status: FIFO saturation reaching this edge under actual static production schedule has not been proved here. The source detector and omitted connection are exact; do not manufacture a healthy-traffic overflow witness.
obligations.capture_requirement: Retain the qualified write-rejection event locally, with its command identity, before rs_q clearing; connect actual retained health to collector.

obligations.source_legal_transition: Each qkd_ctrl_pc_host_static_nc fo is an HBM sticky registered OR of local causes and fi with self-hold until hr_q reset; each inserted qkd_rlys_1 forwards without reset. KC f1/f2/kf reset independently in core.
obligations.observable_obligation: Any valid controller error remains attributable through actual HBM relay edges into a live core capture, or is retained before the independent source reset erases it.
obligations.global_legal_trace_status: No selected legal loss trace asserted. Ordinary fixed-phase HBM/core crossing is not automatically a lost pulse; prove actual clocks/reset releases/PLL behavior and source event width. No-reset startup X is not a fault.
obligations.capture_requirement: Source-local sticky capture uses detector enable and ownership, not raw fi startup. Price and verify independent reset/PLL event retention separately.

obligations.source_legal_transition: Core edge e with !reset, start=1 and valid start parameters executes fault<=0 regardless of old fault or simultaneous zh_err/rc_fault. IO forwards pre-edge core fault, so this is not proof every past error vanishes at hf.
obligations.observable_obligation: An earlier valid-owned pass error must veto its commit and survive a subsequent start/reset; a coincident old-pass arithmetic pulse must retain old identity rather than become a new-pass event.
obligations.global_legal_trace_status: Selected schedule must establish whether old valid returns can coincide with start, whether hf already exposed a previous fault, and whether prior pass was already committed. No legal coincident production trace proved here.
obligations.capture_requirement: Capture valid_out&&err!=0 with originating pass at arithmetic return or prove actual draining/spacing. Capture local protocol predicates under their exact !start&&active guard; never OR invalid raw err into global health.

obligations.source_legal_transition: her[260] captures own&&er[260], own derived from !emb_boot_ready; host boot path presents normal_er only under its verified/nonfault ownership condition.
obligations.observable_obligation: Only genuine valid/owned controller or HOST detector faults must survive. Inactive/unowned er bits and intentional boot suppression have no standalone fault meaning.
obligations.global_legal_trace_status: No selected legal lost causal event asserted from gating alone. Match exact controller event, command ownership, boot verification and export edge before claiming a loss.
obligations.capture_requirement: Use source detector predicate and ownership before a clear can erase it, not ungated er[260]. Keep boot fault as its own separately exposed source.
